This is how you can play GTA 6 18 hours early on Xbox:

> Turn on your Xbox
> Go to Settings
> System → Language & Location
> Change your Location to New Zealand
> Restart your console.

That’s it. It only takes 20 seconds & you’re ready to play up to 18 hours early.

author: complex
text:
A GTA 6 fan who hoped to live long enough to play the game has died after complications from a lung transplant.

Jerry, known online as Void Only, went viral after sharing his battle with lung disease and his wish to play GTA 6. Supporters raised $50,000 to help, and he received a transplant in September. His sister confirmed that he died over the weekend and thanked everyone who supported him. Fans have since shared tributes in his memory.

Rest in peace, Jerry, also known as Void Only 🕊️

[📷: Paris Fort/ TT/Voidonly/ Rockstar Games]
